Declared scope limit in the registration's regime: the loop repairs envelope-level FAILs — a verdict field inside a solver's outputs is data, not a loop failure. The kernel-settle tier (SXE-21) rides NOT_COMPUTED engine_unavailable:sxe-21 in every run. Standing guard added at this build: orc.iterate always excludes ITSELF from the inner loop's solver set, named in the outputs.
